baseline_diagnostics.interpretation: Historical quadratic diagnostic of the explicitly labelled weight representation. Raw exposures whose sum differs from one are not a fully-invested portfolio. This is not expected future return or realized post-decision performance.
baseline_diagnostics.compounded_return_reason: Daily paths and a holdings/rebalancing rule are absent; no inference from sector means or a weighted sum of compounded returns.

source_metadata.units: Daily decimal vendor-adjusted-close returns and daily decimal-squared sample covariance; no RF subtraction.

unrecomputed: The visible payload has no 60 by 11 daily return observations. Daily means, sample covariance and 60-day compounded returns cannot be recomputed from raw time series here.
The 60-day compounded return is not inferred from mean*60 or (1+mean)^60.
No portfolio 60-day compounded return is inferred without a rebalancing/holdings path.
visible_market_facts.approximation: Quadratic forms use exact fractions of serialized input decimals; square roots/correlations are 60-digit Decimal approximations to those inputs, not extra source precision.
